thread:
incident_bot: Pager: apigateway: elevated 5xx (502/504) spike in us-east-1 edge cluster — 15%+ errors over 5m. Auto-escalation to #incidents. Links: https://pd.example/incident/INC-3219 :rotating_light:
maya_ops: acknowledged — I'm on call, jumping in. Starting quick blast radius and customer-impact check.
sanjay_oncall: seeing same in dashboards — spike aligns with last deploy at 3219871200 (ingress routing PR).
maya_ops: ETA 5m for first triage. Can someone post recent deploy sha and config diff?
lars_infra: recent change: ingress-route-override merged 3219871100 by @carol. Diff attached in PR 987. Suspect new header rewrite.
emily_support: support -> +12 tickets in last 10m, two customers report timeouts on embeddings endpoint, one enterprise (Acme Corp) on a critical job.
kevin_pg: running quick health checks on backends — upstream services look healthy, error appears to be gateway-level.
sanjay_oncall: logs show a pattern: upstream responds 200 but edge returns 502 when chunked transfer present. Sample log:
```
[2026-03-17T12:01:03Z] edge-proxy: conn_id=12345 recv chunked body, upstream 200 OK, response aborted on write: EPIPE
[2026-03-17T12:01:03Z] router: route=svc-embed shard=2 backend_latency=42ms
```
maya_ops: ok that smells like improved header/rewrite causing transfer-encoding mismatch. Rolling back ingress-route-override in staging first, then prod if confirmed.
lars_infra: staging rollback applied. Monitoring staging for 5m.
kevin_pg: meanwhile enabling circuit-breaker on edge pool for us-east-1 for suspect routes (/v1/embeddings, /v1/generate) to reduce blast radius. Command run:
```
redwoodctl traffic adjust --region us-east-1 --route "/v1/embeddings","/v1/generate" --circuit-breaker enable --threshold 5%
```
maya_ops: applied CB, traffic drop to suspect pool -30% immediate.
emily_support: customer tickets slowing but Acme still hitting failures intermittently. I sent a note that we're throttling and rolling config.
sanjay_oncall: staging shows error drop to ~1.8% after rollback. Proceeding to prod rollback now.
kevin_pg: prod rollback applied at 3219876780. Watchdog alarms set.
maya_ops: metrics update: us-east-1 5xx dropped from 18% -> 3% in 4m after rollback+CB. Latency normalized.
incident_bot: Alert: 5xx rate decreased below threshold. Monitoring for 30m.
ops_manager: great job. Please prepare short incident summary and list of next steps (postmortem owners, revert cause, long-term fix). Assigning postmortem to @lars_infra and @maya_ops.
lars_infra: noted. Initial hypothesis: header rewrite + chunked encoding edge bug. We'll capture root cause and test vectors.
kevin_pg: left a temporary mitigation: explicit strip of Transfer-Encoding header in edge for those paths until we ship patch.
emily_support: I'll close the high-severity tickets after confirming with Acme.
sanjay_oncall: handing off to night oncall @maya_ops for monitoring for next 2 hours.
maya_ops: accepted handoff. Will escalate immediately if any regression.
ops_manager: timeline to include in postmortem: detection -> CB + staging rollback -> prod rollback -> stabilization. Postmortem draft due EOD. :+1:
